page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Handwritten annotations in the left and right margins, which are excluded from the transcription. Running head at the top, page number 136.

main_text.p: dimidia pars eius precij in re uendita,tradita est. In summa,fraudatio supra dimidiū ueri precij admissa dicitur,cū aut pecunia dimidiū rei, aut res dimidium pecuniæ non ualet. De iure,fatis iam à nobis explicatum uidetur.nunc ad eas controuersias, quæ ex scripto pariuntur, transeundum est: quarum triplicē esse rationem,superius diceba-mus. eas enim aut ex scripti ambiguitate, aut ex scripti sententiēque dissensione,aut ex contrariè scriptis manare. Scripti ergo ambiguitas con-troversiam efficit, cùm (ut Cornificius ait) scriptū duas aut

page.notes: Handwritten annotations in the left and right margins (cursive ink, not printed) are excluded. Paragraph division is uncertain: no clear indent is visible, so the text is treated as one paragraph. Long s has been normalised to s.
